How boards are built

Unique Research ranks each metric for the October window across continuous tracking of thousands of AI companies and ~10k products. Stickiness = duration per user. Growth boards = MoM change on the same metric.

Research statement (abridged — same family as Company boards)

WEB/APP device usage only; >10k monthly visits filter; mixed sources + Unique Research labeling. Geography: Overseas / Domestic / Outbound as defined in Company boards companion. Metrics: Downloads, Sessions, Active Users, Duration; IAP revenue definition as above. Cite Unique Research; not investment advice.
